title: Google and Synaptics launch Coral-based chips for edge AI
teaser: Google and Synaptics have introduced three processors built around Google’s open Coral neural-processing-unit architecture, targeting AI workloads in wearables and industrial devices. The launch is less about a new peak-performance record than about making it easier to run compact models across different chips: Coral is open to commercial use, and Synaptics is pairing it with tools for moving models between platforms.
